goal:
Build an AI animation agent platform (oiioii-style) with full engineering surface: auth, projects, creative workflow orchestration (script -> character -> scene -> storyboard -> render -> sound), job system, asset store, MediaGenerationService using API keys from env, workflow/jobs/assets APIs, and a polished workspace UI with agent timeline and asset gallery. Handle media failures as structured job failures.
Acceptance criteria (must eventually all pass):
- [scaffold] Project scaffold exists
- [architecture] ARCHITECTURE.md exists
- [tests] Test suite exists
CURRENT HARD FAILURES -- prioritize fixing these:
- [scaffold] missing path: README.md
- [architecture] missing path: ARCHITECTURE.md
- [tests] missing path: tests
Work in the project directory. Prefer editing existing code over rewriting everything. Use tools. Run tests. Do not claim completion until criteria are actually satisfied.

open_todos.content: Research oiioii.ai feature list and API capabilities
Design authentication and user management system
Design workflow orchestration API (script -> character -> scene -> storyboard -> render -> sound)
Design job system and media failure handling

next_action: todo: Design asset store and MediaGenerationService
research_notes: search:oiioii.ai AI animation agent platform features API
acceptance_criteria: [scaffold] Project scaffold exists with backend (FastAPI) and frontend (React) directories
[architecture] ARCHITECTURE.md documents system design, data models, API surface
[tests] Test suite exists and passes (pytest for backend, vitest/jest for frontend)
[auth] User signup/login endpoints with JWT, password hashing (bcrypt)
[projects] CRUD for animation projects per user
[workflow] Pipeline that chains script -> character -> scene -> storyboard -> render -> sound
[jobs] Async job queue with status tracking and structured failure handling
[assets] Asset store with download/upload, integrated into MediaGenerationService
[ui] Workspace page with agent timeline visualization and asset gallery
[secrets] All API keys loaded from environment, never hardcoded
